cases.customer_question: Can an existing product qualification be updated after an Android OS Host/Profile change by reusing an already qualified Controller and historical test reports, including reports originally generated by another test facility?
question_variants: Can we reuse previous Bluetooth test reports for a Host/Profile update?
Can another company's historical test reports support a qualification update?
Do Host and Profile subsystem changes require full retesting?
Can an existing Controller qualification be retained while updating Host and Profile layers?
Is qualification reuse allowed when Android updates change Bluetooth Host functionality?
cases.actual_issue: A product's Host Subsystem and Profile Subsystem changed due to an Android update while the Controller qualification remained unchanged. The qualification strategy depended on reusing existing Controller evidence and historical test reports instead of generating a completely new qualification baseline.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The Bluetooth functionality above the controller changed because of a software update, but the controller itself stayed the same. The question is whether the existing qualification evidence can still be reused. The discussion concludes that reuse is possible if the qualification is structured around the existing approved controller design and the updated Host/Profile designs.
cases.consultant_answer: Historical test reports can be reused, including reports generated by another test facility, for the planned qualification update. The consultant recommends building the updated qualification around the new Host/Core Configuration and Profile design while continuing to include the existing qualified Controller design. Before proceeding, the included design hierarchy should be reviewed for inter-layer inconsistencies caused by the new Host/Profile combination.
cases.decision_logic: The Controller design remains unchanged and already has an accepted qualification. Therefore the update focuses on the changed Host and Profile layers rather than requalifying the entire Bluetooth stack. Qualification reuse is acceptable provided the resulting design passes the required layer consistency checks.
cases.final_recommendation: Reuse the existing qualified Controller design and historical test evidence, include the updated Host and Profile designs, and validate the resulting design hierarchy for consistency before submission.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Unnecessary retesting, avoidable qualification effort, or qualification failure can occur if unchanged layers are requalified unnecessarily or if inter-layer inconsistencies introduced by the updated Host/Profile combination are not reviewed before submission.
